changeSet.author: lot1
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE notification_utilisateur DROP CONSTRAINT ck_notification_utilisateur_type;
ALTER TABLE notification_utilisateur ADD CONSTRAINT ck_notification_utilisateur_type CHECK (type IN ('MESSAGE', 'TACHE', 'RAPPORT', 'DEMANDE', 'MENTION', 'REPONSE'));

column.name: conversation_id
column.remarks: Conversation de la messagerie (MESSAGE, MENTION, REPONSE), sinon null.

changeSet.sql: UPDATE notification_utilisateur SET conversation_id = reference_id WHERE reference_service = 'collaboration' AND reference_type = 'CONVERSATION';
CREATE INDEX ix_notification_utilisateur_conversation ON notification_utilisateur (destinataire_id, conversation_id) WHERE lue_le IS NULL AND conversation_id IS NOT NULL;
